title: iris chamaeiris subsp. balkana
intro: Iris chamaeiris subsp. balkana, commonly known as Balkan iris, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. It is a perennial plant native to the Balkan Peninsula and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Balkan iris include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids and glycosides, which possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
